title: LPRB Opinion No. 5 — Failure to Comply with Fee Arbitration Decision
text:
LAWYERS PROFESSIONAL RESPONSIBILITY BOARD
Repealed: January 26, 2006
OPINION NO. 5

It is professional misconduct for an attorney who has signed an agreement to arbitrate a fee
dispute to refuse to honor and carry out the final decision reached in such proceedings. See In Re
Pearson, 352 N.W.2d 415 (Minn. 1984).
Adopted: April 19, 1974.
Amended: December 4, 1987.
Repealed: January 26, 2006.
